newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria lev firms to 2,040-2,060 per dollar at cl.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria lev firms to 2,040-2,060 per dollar at cl.

text.p: The Bulgarian lev firmed to 2,040-2,060 per dollar at close from the morning's 2,140-2,220, as foreign currency demand fell, dealers said.
"Dollar demand eased in the afternoon, helping the lev to recover from the morning dip," one dealer said.
The lev edged down to 2,140-2,220 per dollar at opening from Wednesday's close of 2,130-2,150 due to the longer value date of spot deals and higher dollar demand.
Banks and clients alike preferred to pare long forex positions amid the current lev stability, traders said.

"I expect the lev to trade in a 2,000-2,300 range in the next couple of days, especially if no large final clients come to the market bidding for dollars," another trader said. -- Anastas Petrov, Sofia Newsroom, (++359-2) 981 8569
